newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Reith says wages picture benign.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Reith says wages picture benign.

text.p: Australian Workplace Relations Minister Peter Reith said on Friday the overall wages picture in Australia was benign and did not pose a risk to low inflation.
"There are some pretty big claims around by some of the building industry, the electricians and the like, but the overall wages picture is relatively benign," Reith told reporters.

Asked if those larger wage claims were enough to put pressure on inflation, he said: "No I don't think that at this point in time we have seen agreements entered into and deals done which would have that effect."
But Reith warned trade union leaders that if they went for very big wage increases they would put at risk Australia's low inflation and low interest rate regime.

Australia's annual underlying inflation rate fell to 1.7 percent in the June quarter, its lowest level since the series began in 1971, while average weekly earnings grew 3.7 percent in the second quarter, its lowest level since August 1994.
